summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Bitwise Chainlink ETF Beneficial Interest (CLNK) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long link, short usd currency. The fund provides exposure to LINK, the native token of the Chainlink network, by holding the digital asset directly, less expenses. The trust is passively managed and does not use leverage or derivatives CLNK was launched on Jan 13, 2026 and is issued by Bitwise.
